Object layer (pod frontend-655595bc76-tzgvz Ready, Conditions all True, 0 restarts) and config (CHECKOUT_SERVICE_ADDR=checkoutservice:5050 correctly resolves to the existing checkoutservice Service) are clean; the recurring FailedCreate 'serviceaccount not found' events are stale setup history since all referenced ServiceAccounts exist and all workloads run, and the minor 503s on /product/{id} and /setCurrency coincide with the environment's periodic rollout churn (endpoint-less upstreams), not with any object-layer break.
